name: Two Sum (Unsorted)
description: Finds two indices in an unsorted array whose values sum to target using a hash map for O(n) solution.
aim: For each element x, check if (target-x) was seen before. Store each element in a hash map as we scan.
howItWorks: Else: store arr[i] → i in map

complexity.spaceDescription: Hash map stores up to n elements

alternatives: Two pointers on sorted array — O(n log n) total
